products.name: Sada Chai
products.description: سادہ چائے — the everyday cup. Milk and loose leaf tea boiled together until it turns that deep caramel colour, served hot.

products.name: Gur Wali Chai
products.description: گڑ والی چائے — sweetened with jaggery instead of sugar, which gives it a deeper, earthier finish. A winter favourite.

products.name: Chai Kettli
products.description: چائے کیتلی — a full kettle rather than a single cup, meant to be shared across the table.

products.name: Badam Wali Chai
products.description: بادام والی چائے — brewed with ground almonds for a richer, creamier cup.

products.name: Kashmiri Chai
products.description: کشمیری چائے — slow-churned pink chai finished with crushed pistachio and almond. Takes longer to make, worth the wait.

products.name: Sulemani Qehwa
products.description: سلیمانی قہوہ — black tea with no milk, brewed light. The cup you order after a heavy paratha.

products.name: Sabz Qehwa
products.description: سبز قہوہ — green tea leaves steeped in hot water. Clean, light and easy on the stomach.

products.name: Doodh Qehwa
products.description: دودھ قہوہ — qehwa finished with milk. Lighter than a full doodh patti, warmer than a plain qehwa.

products.name: Coffee
products.description: کافی — hot coffee, for the nights when chai alone is not getting the work finished.

products.name: Lachha Dar Paratha
products.description: لچھا دار پراٹھا — rolled into fine layers so it pulls apart in strands. Crisp outside, soft inside.

products.name: Khushk Paratha
products.description: خشک پراٹھا — cooked dry on the tawa with no added oil. The lightest paratha on the board.

products.name: Aloo Paratha
products.description: آلو پراٹھا — stuffed with spiced potato, green chilli and coriander, then pressed on the tawa till golden.

products.name: Desi Ghee Paratha
products.description: دیسی گھی پراٹھا — made with pure desi ghee. Heavier, richer, and exactly what it sounds like.

products.name: Cheese Paratha
products.description: چیز پراٹھا — mozzarella melted right through to the edges. Regular size.

products.name: Cheese Paratha (Large)
products.description: چیز پراٹھا — the larger portion, for when one regular is not going to be enough.

products.name: Anda Pizza Paratha
products.description: انڈہ پیزا پراٹھا — egg, pizza sauce and cheese layered over the paratha and folded like a pizza.

products.name: Omelette Cheese Paratha
products.description: آملیٹ چیز پراٹھا — a full omelette and melted cheese folded into the paratha.

products.name: Aloo Cheese Paratha
products.description: آلو چیز پراٹھا — the aloo paratha with mozzarella added on top of the potato filling.

products.name: Chocolate Paratha
products.description: چاکلیٹ پراٹھا — chocolate melted into the layers and served warm. The dessert of the menu.

products.name: Malai Paratha
products.description: ملائی پراٹھا — fresh cream and sugar folded in. Simple and very rich.

products.name: Kabab Roll Paratha
products.description: کباب رول پراٹھا — seekh kabab with onion and chutney, rolled tight inside a paratha.

products.name: Chicken Roll Paratha
products.description: چکن رول پراٹھا — spiced chicken, onion and sauce rolled into a paratha. Easy to eat one-handed.

products.name: Chicken Paratha
products.description: چکن پراٹھا — shredded masala chicken packed into the paratha and sealed on the tawa.

products.name: Chicken Cheese Paratha
products.description: چکن چیز پراٹھا — masala chicken and mozzarella together. Needs both hands.

products.name: Chicken Cheese Pizza Paratha
products.description: چکن چیز پیزا پراٹھا — the heaviest build on the board: chicken, mozzarella, pizza sauce and oregano.

products.name: Full Fry

products.name: Cheese Omelette
